fields.name: media_foreground
fields.label: Foreground image
fields.description: The car shown on the left half of the card.

fields.name: media_priceAmount
fields.label: Pricing: amount (₹)
fields.description: The reservation amount in rupees, e.g. 10000 or 10,000: shown as ₹10,000 and charged through Razorpay.

fields.name: media_priceBadge
fields.label: Pricing: badge
fields.description: The small tag beside the label; leave empty for none.

fields.name: media_priceNote
fields.label: Pricing: note
fields.value: Total payable today. Refundable until you confirm your order. You’ll complete payment securely with our payment partner.

fields.name: content_subheading
fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Allocation opens December 2026. Cars are assigned in the order reservations are placed.

fields.name: content_disclaimer
fields.label: Disclaimer text
fields.description: The small print below the button.
fields.value: JSW Motors processes this data only for the purpose above, under the DPDP Act, 2023. Consent is optional and you can withdraw it or request erasure anytime at privacy@jswmotors.com. Full Privacy Notice.

fields.name: form_action
fields.label: Form action URL
fields.description: Where the form data will be sent. Not used yet: the button currently goes straight to the Button link.

fields.name: form_cities
fields.label: City options
fields.description: The choices of the Select City list: click Add for each city.

fields.name: form_razorpayKey
fields.label: Razorpay Key ID
fields.description: The public Key ID only: rzp_test_… (testing) or rzp_live_… (live). NEVER enter the Key Secret here: everything in this block is published on the website.

fields.name: form_checkoutName
fields.label: Razorpay: name shown
fields.description: The name at the top of the Razorpay payment window.

fields.name: form_checkoutDescription
fields.label: Razorpay: description
fields.description: The line under the name in the Razorpay payment window.

fields.name: form_button
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: The page opened after a successful payment (the confirmation page).

fields.name: form_failure
fields.label: Failure page link
fields.description: The page opened when the payment fails. (The Button link above is the page opened when it succeeds.)

fields.name: fields_cityPlaceholder
fields.label: City dropdown placeholder
fields.description: The first, empty choice of the city list (the cities are the City options field).
